title: Flowermate Mini Pro Vaporizer V5s
description:
Who is the Flowermate Mini Pro for?

The Mini Pro is perfect for anyone looking for a discreet, stylish, pocketable vape with full temperature control at an affordable price. The most advanced vaporizer in the Flowermate V5 line in our opinion.

Vapor quality

The Flowermate Mini Pro has a short air path, but the glass mouthpiece does a good job at cooling the vapor, giving you a smooth draw. The flavor is good and you get about 10-15 inhales from a fully loaded chamber.

Easy to use. Fast heat up time.

Using the Flowermate V5s Mini Pro is simple. Just turn the unit on, load the chamber and within 30 seconds the unit is heated up and you’re ready to vape. Don’t worry about your technique, the Mini Pro’s temperature settings are programmed so that you will never combust.

Battery life

The Flowermate Mini Pro is powered by a high quality 1800mAh battery. Which delivers up to 75 minutes of vaporization. Also, the Mini Pro features a 5 minute auto off shut off to preserve battery life and USB pass through charging, allowing you to use the unit while it is plugged in. With it charging via USB you can also use any USB power bank to recharge the unit on the go for longer sessions.

Complete temperature control

The Flowermate V5s Mini Pro gives you great control, operating from 104°F – 446°F (40°C – 230°C). Compared to the Flowermate Mini and Flowermate v5.0s non-pro models, the Mini Pro allows for lower temperature vaporization for a more aromatic flavor or higher temperatures for concentrates.

Adjustable airflow

The Flowermate Mini Pro gives extra control allowing you to adjust the airflow to match your preference. This combined with Flowermate’s new screens for 2016, the Mini Pro breathes easy.

Concentrate & flower pods

The Mini Pro includes both stainless steel herb and concentrate pods. The herb pod is not required to use the Flowermate V5s Mini Pro, but it allows you to bring a pre-loaded pod for an extended portable session.

Works worldwide

The Mini Pro works on 100-240V, so anywhere in the world. It charges via USB, no power transformer is required.

Digital control

The Flowermate Mini Pro features an OLED digital display showing off Current Temp, Set Temp, and an extremely helpful Battery Level indicator. You’ll know exactly what your Mini Pro is doing, if you need to re-charge or if your good for another session.

Quality construction. Stylish.

The Mini Pro’s foundation is in quality materials featuring a ceramic heating chamber, pyrex mouthpiece, and an anodized aluminum shell. In our opinion, this is the most polished, stylish Flowermate to date.

Discreet. Pocket size.

The Flowermate V5s Mini Pro easily tucks away in your pocket and looks and acts like a power bank, charge any USB device! The chamber and mouthpiece are hidden in sliding compartments giving off very little odor when not in use. The Mini is very small and measures in at 1.75″ W x .75″ D x 3.4″ H

User manual

Download the Mini Pro V5s manual here.

Warranty

The Mini Pro comes with a 1-year warranty against manufacturer’s defect and a 3-month warranty on the batteries. You will need your device’s serial number to be eligible for warranty work, which can be located on the back of the box on a sticker. As with all vaporizers purchased from Planet Of The Vapes, you are also covered by our 100% Satisfaction Guarantee.
